name: Grave Shield
body:
School abjuration; Level death mage 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

You call your personal spirits to form a barrier to protect you in the mortal world. This creates a flickering disk of swirling grey forms, which moves to intercept any threat to you. While this has no effect on hit point damage, the grave shield does weaken many effects the dead and undead are immune to. You gain a +1 luck bonus to all saving throws against mind‑affecting effects, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, stunning effects, energy drains, and exhaustion and fatigue effects. This bonus increases every 5 caster levels, to +2 at 5th level, +3 at at 10th level, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.
